### Resolution status

- YELLOW-A (library page i18n wiring): FOLDED IN at `615a7e0`

### Pre-flight

```bash

git log --oneline -1                 # 0aa63d8 i18n(library): split catalog-stats keys...
git fetch origin
git log --oneline origin/main..HEAD  # should be 33 commits ahead
```

### Merge procedure (per common-prompt.md L142-148)

**Always merge locally, never via `gh pr merge`** — that bypasses the prepare-commit-msg hook which adds Co-authored-by.

Run as a single atomic chain (chained per [[atomic-git-chaining]]):

```bash
git fetch origin && \
  git checkout main && \
  git pull --ff-only && \
  git merge --squash feat/library-page-ui-kit && \
  git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
feat(#60): /library page + 21-component UI kit on the design system

Library page composed from a paper-on-wood-grain-desk metaphor: three
PaperStack instances (Returns / Overdue / Pull for tonight) on a
DeskSurface with an ambient catalog strip beneath. New nav (MvoxNav)
replaces the inline layout nav. Auth pages (/auth/login + /auth/logout)
redesigned on the same design system, preserving all CHORE-B logic
(storage, OAuth flow, redirect timers).

UI kit delivered: 21 reusable Svelte 5 components in src/lib/components/
plus DeskSurface + MvoxNav + ProviderButton; design tokens + Caveat/Inter/
JetBrains Mono fonts in src/app.css @theme block.

i18n: 64 new paraglide keys across messages/{en,et,lv,uk}.json wired
through /library + /auth pages. Three keys ship with TODO et/lv/uk
markers (library_overdue_marginalia) pending PO copy.

Test infra: @testing-library/svelte v5 added, vitest.config.ts switched
to mergeConfig(viteConfig) with resolve.conditions=['browser'] to support
.svelte component render tests. src/tests/snippet-helpers.ts exports
textSnippet for createRawSnippet boilerplate.

Architecture correction included: Margin/PaperStack/DeskSurface/PaperCard
children typed as Snippet with {@render children()} per Bentham verdict
[ARCH-VERDICT 2026-05-24 CHORE-60], aligning the primitives with the
load-bearing layout precedent. Initial () => string typing was a
session-21 convention error caught at /library page composition.

Layout: src/routes/+layout.svelte restructured to drop max-w-5xl
wrapper (auth pages now use DeskSurface chrome). src/routes/library/
+layout.svelte added as pass-through escape from any wrapper.

Tests: 436/436 unit pass. No new Playwright regressions
(12 pre-existing failures verified identical on main before merge).

Carry-forward YELLOWs filed as follow-up issues:
- #62 MvoxNav i18n keys missing
- #63 textSnippet helper Svelte warning fix

Closes #60

Co-authored-by: Mihkel Putrinš <mihkel.putrinsh@gmail.com>
EOF
)" && \
  git push origin main && \
  git status
```

ASCII-only commit message (no em-dashes — L72). The above body is verified clean.

### After merge succeeds

Delete the feature branch (remote + local):

```bash
git push origin --delete feat/library-page-ui-kit && \
  git branch -d feat/library-page-ui-kit
```

If local delete refuses ("not fully merged" because the squash creates a different commit hash than the branch tip), use `git branch -D feat/library-page-ui-kit`.

- `git log --oneline -2` post-push (verify main moved + history is clean)
- Confirmation feature branch deleted (remote + local)
- Any unexpected output from the chain

Per memory [[wrangler-deploy-auth]]: CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN lives in `/home/michelek/.config/mvox/credentials.env`, not in shell env. Source it inline, then deploy.

```bash
set -a
```

```bash
curl -sI https://multivox.pages.dev/ | head -5
```

Expect 200 on all four. The CF response headers should change (`etag` or `cf-ray` or `last-modified`) reflecting the new build.

[2026-05-24 05:58] **mvox.eu DNS rebind — Team Task #74.** PO authorized. Finn's probe (Task #73) found: Pages binding on `multivox` for `mvox.eu` is `pending` since 2026-05-23 22:58 UTC because the apex CNAME → `multivox.pages.dev` was never created; existing A/AAAA records route to some other origin (Workers site or static asset, unknown).

### Token scope warning

Finn's probe found CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN has account-level Pages rights but **lacks Zone DNS/Workers read scope** — DNS API queries returned `Authentication error`. There's a real chance this entire task fails on first DNS read. **If your first DNS API call returns auth error, STOP and report — don't try to work around it.** PO will fall back to dashboard fix.

### Source credentials

```bash
set -a
source /home/michelek/.config/mvox/credentials.env
set +a
```

### Steps (READ ALL existing records FIRST — don't delete blindly)

Zone ID: `8c9bc3d0f03502efe6429878cdfb8160`. Confirmed by Finn.

**Step 1 — Probe DNS scope. List all current records:**

```bash
curl -sH "Authorization: Bearer $CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN" \
  "https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/zones/8c9bc3d0f03502efe6429878cdfb8160/dns_records?per_page=100" \
  | jq '.success, (.result // [])[] | {id, type, name, content, proxied, ttl}'
```

If `"success": false` or `Authentication error`: STOP. Report token scope insufficient. PO falls back to dashboard.

If success: capture the full record list in your report — we want a paper trail of pre-change state. Especially the A + AAAA records and any CNAME / MX / TXT.

**Step 2 — Identify records to remove.** Need to remove the apex records that conflict with the CNAME:
- Any A or AAAA record where `name == "mvox.eu"` (apex)
- KEEP all MX records (email routing per session-19), TXT (SPF/DKIM), and any non-apex records (e.g., `www.mvox.eu`)

**Step 3 — DELETE each conflicting apex A/AAAA record:**

For each conflicting record's ID:
```bash
curl -sX DELETE -H "Authorization: Bearer $CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN" \
  "https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/zones/8c9bc3d0f03502efe6429878cdfb8160/dns_records/{record_id}"
```

**Step 4 — CREATE the apex CNAME → multivox.pages.dev:**

```bash
curl -sX POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  "https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/zones/8c9bc3d0f03502efe6429878cdfb8160/dns_records" \
  -d '{
    "type": "CNAME",
    "name": "mvox.eu",
    "content": "multivox.pages.dev",
    "proxied": true,
    "ttl": 1
  }'
```

(CF supports apex CNAME via flattening when proxied=true. TTL 1 = auto.)

**Step 5 — Wait + poll Pages binding status:**

```bash
sleep 30
for i in 1 2 3 4 5; do
  curl -sH "Authorization: Bearer $CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN" \
    "https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/$CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID/pages/projects/multivox/domains" \
    | jq '.result[] | select(.name=="mvox.eu") | .status'
  sleep 15
done
```

Expect transition `pending` → `active` within ~60s once CNAME is live. If still `pending` after 90s, report and stand by — may need PO inspection.

**Step 6 — Verify mvox.eu serves new build:**

```bash
curl -sI https://mvox.eu/library
curl -sI https://mvox.eu/auth/login
```

Both should return 200 with `x-sveltekit-page: true` and fresh `cf-ray`. If still 404 or stale, wait another minute and retry (DNS + edge cache propagation).

### Constraints

- DO NOT delete MX, TXT, SRV, or any record where name ≠ `mvox.eu` (apex).
- DO NOT touch the multivox Pages project itself.
- DO NOT touch CF Email Routing rules.
- Single domain mutation only. Do not modify other zones.

### Report

SendMessage team-lead with:
- Pre-change DNS record list (the full JSON or jq output from Step 1)
- IDs of deleted records (with type + content for audit trail)
- Created CNAME record (ID + content)
- Pages binding status transition (pending → active timestamps)
- Final curl results for mvox.eu/library + mvox.eu/auth/login
- Any errors at any step

`TaskUpdate(taskId=74, status=completed)` if Pages binding active + endpoints 200. Otherwise leave in_progress + report blockers.

Proceed.
summary: Rebind mvox.eu DNS via CF API
